thread:
maria: Quick drop — I put together a compact delivery cheat-sheet for enterprise buyers (audience matrix + 1-pager hooks). Wanted a fast sanity check before we send to field. TL;DR: one column for decision-maker, one for primary objection, one-line pitch, routing action. :spiral_note_pad:

jason: Love the structure. Can we add a short SLA callout box for each deployment mode? e.g., Hosted: 99.9% / Dedicated: 99.95 / Private: custom.

lee: +1 SLA box. Sales needs 3 quick bullets per row they can paste into outreach templates. Keep them <25 words.

anya: For CISO/audit audience, include explicit KMS/HSM note and audit-log retention options. They want comms to say "customer-controlled keys" not just "KMS".

maria: Good call. I'll swap to "customer-controlled keys (KMS/HSM)". Also planning short benchmark snippet for latency/cost tradeoffs — do we want a tiny chart or a one-liner?

jason: One-liner for the one-pager and link to benchmark appendix. e.g., "Typical 95th-pct latency: hosted 60–120ms, dedicated 20–50ms (varies with seq len)." Keep conservative numbers.

lee: For routing: field should push finance/compliance leads to a demo request form with the "Private deployment" tag. Marketers should add UTM=enterprise_slas.

anya: Webinar spin: 20-minute customer story + 10-minute product deep dive on deployment options. Title idea: "Serving LLMs at Scale: Security, SLAs, and Deployment Choices." Thoughts?

maria: Title good but long. How about "LLM Serving for Enterprises: Security & SLA Playbook" — shorter for email subject lines.

lee: Works. Also need one outreach line for MQL nurture: "Get predictable latency and enterprise-grade controls for LLM features — see our quick brief."

maria: Drafting 3 subject lines and 4 hero CTAs. Putting assets in the folder. ops-bot can you post link to the draft PDF + editable figma?

ops-bot: Uploaded assets -> https://drive.internal/redwood/enterprise-cheatsheet/v1 (permissions: marketing, field-sales). File names: cheat_sheet_v1.pdf, cheat_sheet_v1.fig.

jason: In the cheat-sheet please include a tiny decisions matrix (rows: security, latency, cost; columns: Hosted / Dedicated / Private) with green/amber/red indicators + one-line rationale. That helps quick qual.

maria: Will add. Also adding two short benchmark blurbs: "Cost per 1k tokens (approx): hosted $0.20, dedicated $0.08*, private variable (*depends on infra)." Keep it prefaced with "typical" and link to full bench.

anya: For the CISO callout, add a sample compliance sentence: "Supports SOC2, ISO27001; deployable into customer VPCs with audit logs and BYOK."

lee: Can we get a 1-sentence objection handling for each row? e.g., "We can't rely on hosted": "We offer Dedicated and Private with contractual SLAs and isolation controls."

maria: Nice. I'll add 1-liners under each objection. Once I update, can we all do a quick pass by EOD? I'm trying to get final to design tomorrow morning.

jason: I can review noon PST.

lee: Afternoon ok for me, ping in channel when ready.

anya: I'll do a security pass after jason.

maria: Thanks team — I'll update now and post the PDF+copy for final read. :rocket:
